TextContext.SourceString: （因为受到剪刀手组织的“特殊关照”而前往了他们的基地。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having received some “special care” from The Scissors, I end up at their base.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在这期间，拉薇提出了想要见面的请求，受邀来到了她的个人住所。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When I arrive, Lawine asks that we meet at her residence.)

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前的拉薇换上了与作战服不同的着装，一身素白，简约淡雅。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine looks so different outside of her combat attire. Adorned in plain white, she gives off an air of simplicity and elegance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到和你是以这种形式相见……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't expect for us to meet like this...

TextContext.SourceString: 初次见面，引航者，我是拉薇。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pleasure to meet you, Navigator. I'm Lawine.

TextContext.SourceString: 不必紧张，我没有携带武器，今天找你只是来闲聊的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No need to worry, I'm not armed. We're here to parley.

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇……你是剪刀手的那位执行者？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lawine... You're the executor of The Scissors, aren't you?

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇稍作沉默，幽蓝色的瞳孔上下打量。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine remains silent as her blue eyes look me up and down.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……传闻中的引航者居然知道我，真是荣幸。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...So the storied Navigator has heard of me. I should be honored.

TextContext.SourceString: 你认识我？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You know who I am?

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇轻点了点头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine responds with a faint nod.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……不过大致的了解都是基于传闻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Though, I admit, most of it is purely rumor.

TextContext.SourceString: 我听说，你是一位崩溃症治疗专家，在格罗夫银行大厦危机中表现得非常亮眼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've heard that you're proficient at treating collapse syndrome and that you played a pivotal role in the Grove Bank Incident.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，你才会作为“客人”而被组织邀请。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's why you've been invited here as a “guest.”

TextContext.SourceString: 这段时间，在这里住的还习惯么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How do you find it here?

TextContext.SourceString: （沉默。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Silence.)

TextContext.SourceString: 应该很不适应吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not used to it, are you?

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟你和欧泊、乌尔比诺走得比较近，习惯了那些表面的浮华与安宁。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You walk in P.U.S and Urbino circles. I'm not surprised that you've grown used to superficial comforts.

TextContext.SourceString: （摇头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Shake head.)

TextContext.SourceString: 和我预期的一样。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's as I thought.

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟你和欧泊、乌尔比诺走得比较近，习惯了那些表面的浮华与安宁。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You walk in P.U.S and Urbino circles. I'm not surprised that you've grown used to superficial comforts.

TextContext.SourceString: 在这里如果缺了什么，随时可以提出来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you find something lacking, just say so.

TextContext.SourceString: 作为“客人”，我不让你被亏待的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We won't treat a “guest” with inhospitality.

TextContext.SourceString: （说话的间歇，拉薇桌子上的茶炉水雾袅袅。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As we speak, steam starts escaping from the kettle on Lawine's table.)

TextContext.SourceString: 正好，我煮了点茶。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just in time. The tea's ready.

TextContext.SourceString: 这里也有你的份，算是我个人的待客之道。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's a cup for you, too. This is how I was raised to host people.

TextContext.SourceString: （她小心地斟了两杯，使用的是带有东方风格的小巧茶杯。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine carefully pours the tea into two miniature cups decorated in oriental print.)

TextContext.SourceString: （对拉薇的意图并不清楚，思考着是否应该喝茶……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Still unsure about Lawine's intentions, I mull over the safety of accepting the tea.)

TextContext.SourceString: （小口地喝下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Drink the tea slowly.)

TextContext.SourceString: （热茶有些烫嘴，但茶的清香在舌尖萦绕，非常享受这份独有的鲜醇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The steaming tea is hot in my mouth, but its unique fragrance lingers on the tip of my tongue... incredible.)

TextContext.SourceString: （尽管言语冰冷，但沏茶者一定十分用心。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Despite her cold demeanor, it's clear that Lawine put a lot of effort into this brew.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不得不说，真是一杯好茶！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What an incredible cup of tea, I must say!)

TextContext.SourceString: 唔？你觉得还不错？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? It's to your liking?

TextContext.SourceString: 我随便沏的茶，没什么讲究……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's nothing special...

TextContext.SourceString: 只是一些来自故乡的清茶。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just a pot of fresh tea from my hometown.

TextContext.SourceString: （提及“故乡”时，拉薇冰霜般的脸上似乎有了一些温度。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When she speaks the word “hometown,” a little warmth flows to Lawine's icy demeanor.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在茶香弥漫中，两个人的心情都有所放松。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the fragrance of the tea fills the room, we both relax our guard.)

TextContext.SourceString: （拒绝喝茶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Refuse the tea.)

TextContext.SourceString: （对面前的热茶有所犹豫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hesitate to touch the tea in front of me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对未知者保持必要的戒心，这份机警我是认可的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I respect your vigilance in the face of the unknown.

TextContext.SourceString: ……但是现在并非是在战场。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...But this is not the battlefield.

TextContext.SourceString: 在这里，你就是我的客人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here, you are my guest.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇率先饮下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine takes a sip from her cup.)

TextContext.SourceString: 担心烫的话可以静置一会，不过最好还是趁热饮下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you're worried about scalding your mouth, let it rest for a while. Though it's best to drink the tea while it's hot.

TextContext.SourceString: 茶汤温度高，香气也就随之高扬，此时的茶味与茶香是最佳的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The heat of the water unlocks the flavor of the tea leaves, resulting in the best taste and aroma.

TextContext.SourceString: （不禁被面前的茶香所吸引，端起茶杯缓缓饮下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Drawn in by the aroma coming from the cup, I lift it to my lips and take a tentative sip.)

TextContext.SourceString: （对沏茶者的用心表示认可。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Compliments to the brewer.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在茶香弥漫中，两个人的心情都有所放松。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the fragrance of the tea fills the room, we both relax our guard.)

TextContext.SourceString: （注意到拉薇的桌子上摆放了一盆盆绿植，还有许多与花卉有关的书籍。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I notice the myriad flowerpots on Lawine's table, along with many books related to horticulture.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你很喜欢养花吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You enjoy growing flowers?

TextContext.SourceString: 是你种的盆栽吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: These are your plants?

TextContext.SourceString: 对，养花是我的个人爱好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Indeed. It's a hobby of mine.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇用余光望向那些盆栽。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine looks over the plants out of the corner of her eye.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……有的应该快开花了吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Some of them should bloom soon.

TextContext.SourceString: 你问这些都是些什么花？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What kind of flowers?

TextContext.SourceString: 这种叶片宽大椭圆、花苞较大的叫蝴蝶兰，而那些没有开花迹象的是建兰。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The ones with broad oval-shaped leaves and large buds are moth orchids, while those that still need some time to bloom are spring orchids.

TextContext.SourceString: 建兰的花期会晚一些。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They'll be flowering a bit later.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇在介绍这些花卉时，偶尔会流露出普通女孩的神情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As she introduces all her flowers, I can't help but see Lawine as an ordinary girl.)

TextContext.SourceString: （抛去执行者的身份，原来她也会种种花草、泡泡热茶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She's not just an executor... she also knows how to grow flowers and make great tea.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，你问这些做什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... why do you ask?

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到拉薇也会有这样的爱好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I just didn't expect you to have such a hobby.

TextContext.SourceString: 很惊讶么？你为什么会对这些事情感兴趣呢，引航者？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Does it surprise you? Why the interest, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: ……爱好什么的，无关紧要吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...This hobby or that, does it matter?

TextContext.SourceString: 正如拉薇所说的，我们只是在闲聊啊——
TextContext.LocalizedString: As you said, we're just chatting.

TextContext.SourceString: 通过面谈好像了解拉薇不一样的一面。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This face-to-face has given me a better idea of the kind of person Lawine is.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者本人倒是……和传闻中的相差不大。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're not too different from the rumors, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 很好奇传闻中的我是什么样的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'd be curious to know what the rumors say about me.

TextContext.SourceString: “爱管闲事又不按套路出牌”，“拥有深藏不露的本领”，“能够独自应对崩溃症的可怕家伙”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Nosy and doesn't play by the rules,” “full of hidden strength,” and “one who has the power to deal with collapse syndrome all on their own.”

TextContext.SourceString: ——大致就是这些。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...That's the general idea.

TextContext.SourceString: 传得过于夸张了，拉薇别被小道消息带偏了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: These rumors are just exaggerations, Lawine. Don't be led astray by gossip...

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，眼见为实，传闻未必可靠。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's true. Seeing is believing - rumors are never quite reliable.

TextContext.SourceString: 但你既然成为了我们的“客人”，引航者，这就代表着我们认可了你的实力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But, we wouldn't have asked you to be our “guest” if we didn't recognize your strength, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: （聊天期间，茶渐渐喝完了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I gradually empty my cup as we continue chatting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （用期待的目光看向拉薇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I look at Lawine expectantly.)

TextContext.SourceString: 还想再来一杯么？看起来这种清茶很对你的胃口。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Would you like some more? Seems like it's to your liking.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇再次倒了一杯茶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine pours another cup of tea.)

TextContext.SourceString: （准备接过茶杯的时候，递过来的却是一张印有剪刀手标记的通行凭证。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I reach to take the cup from her, she hands me a pass embossed with the mark of The Scissors.)

TextContext.SourceString: 算是初见的一点见面礼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Consider this a welcome gift.

TextContext.SourceString: 持有它就能在允许的范围内自由行动，临时出入部分场所。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This pass will give you limited access to our territory, within reason, of course.

TextContext.SourceString: 在这里待久了，你应该也想到外面走走吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's been a while since you arrived. I'm sure you want to stretch your legs.

TextContext.SourceString: 另外，茶有些凉了，我给你热一热再喝吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Looks like the tea's grown a little cold. Let me heat it up for you.

PrologueTitle.LocalizedString: A Mentor as Well as a Friend

TextContext.SourceString: （今天接到拉薇的见面邀请，但瞥了一眼近期的工作排期，绝望，叹息——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I received an invitation from Lawine today, but when I glance at my work schedule, I can't help but let out a sigh of despair.)

TextContext.SourceString: （近期星庇所的挂号量满到爆炸，不得已接连加班。可能无法应邀了，拉薇一定会很失望吧……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We've admitted so many patients as of late that everyone's on constant overtime, but I don't want to disappoint Lawine by not showing up...)

TextContext.SourceString: ……谢谢您，引航者，您的嘱咐我都记下了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Thank you, Navigator. I'll make sure to follow your instructions.

TextContext.SourceString: 请记得预约下一期的复诊喔。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't forget to make an appointment for the follow-up.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，这次也麻烦您了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I won't, thank you.

TextContext.SourceString: （完成了对这位病人的治疗，准备呼叫下一位病人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I get ready to call the next patient.)

TextContext.SourceString: 下一位，请进！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Next patient, please!

TextContext.SourceString: （等了很久……迟迟没有人回应。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I wait and wait... but hear no response.)

TextContext.SourceString: （难道……？确认了一下今天的病患问诊表，刚刚那位是最后一位病人！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Eh...? I check the patient list to make sure... that was the last one!)

TextContext.SourceString: （再三确认，的的确确已经完成了今天全部的工作。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I check and double-check to make sure all the work for the day is really done.)

TextContext.SourceString: （没错——可以下班了！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looks right... I can finally get off work!)

TextContext.SourceString: （和拉薇发简讯，得知她还在茶社等候。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I text Lawine. She responds that she’s still at the teahouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我等你过来，上次还没有说完的话……一定要当面告诉你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's fine, I'll wait here. We should finish our last conversation in person.

TextContext.SourceString: （愈发觉得今天的见面，一定不能错过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I get the feeling that I can't miss this meeting.)

TextContext.SourceString: 动身前往茶社
TextContext.LocalizedString: Leave for the teahouse

TextContext.SourceString: （一阵清风拂过，捎带走了积攒数日的疲惫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The breeze blows past me, taking days of fatigue away with it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （怀揣着满心期待走进了约定的茶社。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I mentally prepare myself and step into the teahouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: 好久不见了，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good to see you again, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，我来晚了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry, I'm late.

TextContext.SourceString: 等很久了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Were you waiting for long?

TextContext.SourceString: 来得正好，煮茶也需要一些时间。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're just in time. It takes a while to brew the tea, anyway.

TextContext.SourceString: （含笑的拉薇正坐在桌案前，一旁的茶炉正腾起袅袅茶香。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine sits at the front of the table with a smile on her face, a beautiful aroma rising from the pot next to her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 今天邀请引航者一起，其实是想补全上一次未完的仪式。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I asked you here today so that we could finish our ceremony from last time.

TextContext.SourceString: ……仪式？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Ceremony?

TextContext.SourceString: 是的，是敬茶仪式。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's right. Our tea ceremony.

TextContext.SourceString: 依照家里武馆的习惯，招纳弟子传授衣钵后，还需补上拜师仪式以表尊重与感谢，而敬茶就相当于拜师——
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a tradition of my family dōjō. When passing on one's legacy to a disciple, it is customary for the disciple to hold a ceremony as a show of respect and gratitude. We can do this through tea.

TextContext.SourceString: （正说着拉薇端起茶杯。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine picks up a teacup as she speaks.)

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然是我传授你武艺，但是在心性修炼方面，你拥有不动如山的沉稳内心，我反倒是更像一名弟子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Though I'm the one who's teaching your martial arts, in terms of spirit, you're as immovable as a mountain. Here, I'm the disciple.

TextContext.SourceString: 有幸受到你的点拨与启示，我才能稍微拨开那些迷雾，让混乱迷惘的刀锋平静下来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your guidance and inspiration has cleared away some of the fog and calmed my chaotic blade.

TextContext.SourceString: 唯有获得这份平静，我才能真正地面对那个人……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only with this peace, can I truly face that person...

TextContext.SourceString: 在今天安排敬茶仪式可能有些擅作主张……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Arranging a tea ceremony today may have been a bit presumptuous...

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，引航者，无论如何请让我敬你一杯！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But, Navigator, please allow me this toast!

TextContext.SourceString: （同样拿起茶杯。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I raise my glass with her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呃，你怎么也……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh... why are you...?

TextContext.SourceString: （为拉薇能够抛下迷茫而感到高兴，但面对如此盛情，实在是不好意思。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though I'm happy that Lawine has put aside some of her troubles, I can't help but feel a bit bashful at her hospitality.)

TextContext.SourceString: （明明之前也受到了拉薇很多关照……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Especially with all the help she's given me in the past...)

TextContext.SourceString: 不止拉薇一个人是弟子喔。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're not the only disciple here.

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇，请让我也敬你一杯吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please allow me to toast you, too.

TextContext.SourceString: 不，是我发起的仪式，请让我来敬茶——
TextContext.LocalizedString: That won't do. I was the one who invited you, so allow me to serve the tea...

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇眉头紧皱，两人之间出现了意外中的推脱。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine furrows her brows as we reach an awkward impasse.)

TextContext.SourceString: 互为师，互为友，正因为是这样的关系——
TextContext.LocalizedString: We've become mentors and friends to one another, and that's precisely why...

TextContext.SourceString: 我们才能一同享受品茶的乐趣吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We can sit here and enjoy this tea together!

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇稍作沉思，再次手握茶杯。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine thinks for a moment before raising her cup again.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她的眼睛里再看不到任何犹豫与迷茫，眸子清亮得如同庭院的翠竹，也如同杯里的香茗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her eyes, previously clouded with hesitation and doubt, now shine as clear as the bamboo in her dōjō courtyard or the fragrant tea in our cups.)
Huff...

TextContext.SourceString: （一抹会意的浅笑在她的面颊绽放。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A knowing smile reaches her cheeks.)

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然在初见的时候就一同饮茶，但此时的感觉是完全不同的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We've been drinking tea together since the day we met, but this feeling is entirely different.

TextContext.SourceString: 我曾经以为不断地战斗，在黑夜中沉寂，就是我的宿命。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I once believed that constant and silent struggle was my ultimate calling.

TextContext.SourceString: 遇见了你以后，内心的这种想法似乎渐渐地被抵消……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But after meeting you, this feeling seems to have slowly faded away...

TextContext.SourceString: 家母常说，怀抱着心愿种下一株花草，会收获不一样的“缘”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mother often said that if you plant a seed with your heart's desire, you will sow a different fate.

TextContext.SourceString: 也许是巧合吧？那时候种下的兰草终于开花了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps it's just a coincidence, but... those orchids I planted have finally bloomed.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，“缘”真是妙不可言啊。啊，当然，你也一样。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fate is a wonderful thing, Navigator... not to say that you aren't incredible in your own right.

TextContext.SourceString: （几乎是在同时，二人极为默契地相视而笑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In almost perfect sync, we look at each other with a smile of clear understanding.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一杯香茗饮下，茶香与惬意久久弥散在咽喉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We drink from the cup of fragrant tea, its comforting aroma lingering in our throats.)

TextContext.SourceString: （或许无需多言，庭院的清风与绿竹自然会印证着这一切。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Words don't seem to be needed. The gentle breeze and swaying bamboo bear witness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （再次被安排了与拉薇见面，使用通行证来到了拉薇的住所。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having agreed to meet again, I use my pass to make my way to Lawine's dorm.)

TextContext.SourceString: （谨慎地敲了敲拉薇的房门。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I give the door a few cautious knocks.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……是谁？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Who is it?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是特别紧急的作战行动，先不要来打搅我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If it's not urgent, come back later.

TextContext.SourceString: 看来我来的不是时候……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not a good time...?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，是你啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh. It's you.

TextContext.SourceString: 你应该收到面谈的通知了吧，还是像上次那样，简单聊聊你在基地的近况。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I suppose you got the request to meet. I wanted to talk a bit about how you've been doing, just like last time.

TextContext.SourceString: 请进吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please, come in.

TextContext.SourceString: （跟随着拉薇的步伐进入了屋内。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I follow Lawine into her home.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在房间内没有看到预期中的热茶，却发现拉薇被围困在层层叠叠的文件中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The familiar scent of fresh tea was nowhere to be found. Instead, I found a desk buried under piles of files.)

TextContext.SourceString: （印象中的拉薇与文书工作毫不相关。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Paperwork never really comes to mind when I think about Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇作为执行者，还要兼职文书工作吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are executors responsible for so much paperwork?

TextContext.SourceString: 发生了些特殊情况。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There were some special circumstances.

TextContext.SourceString: 负责记录行动的同伴在战斗中受伤了，目前正在疗养，距离完全恢复还需要一段时间。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The person responsible for recording our battlefield operations was injured in battle. It's going to take some time for them to fully recover.

TextContext.SourceString: 近期的作战行动都无人记录，我不想搁置工作，所以就亲自上了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Someone needs to do it, so it might as well be me.

TextContext.SourceString: 说回你的事，我打算给你补充一批生活物资，有什么需要的可以标注在这张清单上。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But back to you... I'm requisitioning a new batch of supplies. If there's anything you need, just mark it down on this sheet.

TextContext.SourceString: （对即将到来的物资表示期待，暗自思忖该要点什么好。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Excited, I start making a mental note of the supplies I need.

TextContext.SourceString: 补充一下，仅限生活必需品。
TextContext.LocalizedString: To be clear, it's necessities only.

TextContext.SourceString: （清单上面罗列了几种常见的食品、药品及个人清洁用品。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The sheet only spares the luxury of common food items, medicine, and personal hygiene products.)

TextContext.SourceString: （显然没有想要的游戏机和卡带，对于物品种类过于单一而深表遗憾……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Not a single console or game cartridge in sight. Such a shame...)

TextContext.SourceString: （叹气时，看到拉薇又回到了纸张堆成的“围墙”中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I bemoan my situation, I see Lawine returning to the mountain of paperwork.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这种夸张的工作量……一个人能搞定嘛？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So much work... can one person really handle it all?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，不是什么问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm. It's not a big deal.

TextContext.SourceString: 我就是那些战斗的亲历者，根据回忆和录像补充细节，很快就能搞定。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I took part in many of these battles. Based on memory and record, I should be able to get through most of this soon enough.

TextContext.SourceString: 相对麻烦的是纠正以前的错误记录，有一些战斗连我没有参与过，还需要查阅材料佐证。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The troublesome part comes in correcting mistakes, especially for operations that I didn't take part in. I'll have to go through all the records carefully.

TextContext.SourceString: 负伤的那个记录员隐瞒伤情，坚持工作……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The person who was responsible for this work hid their injury from the rest of us and tried to push on...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果我没有及时发现，眼前要处理的工作远不止这个数量级。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we found them out any later, there would be even more work to do.

TextContext.SourceString: （了解了事情的经过，但是无法理解拉薇为何要独自承担。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can understand what happened, but I still don't understand why Lawine must take on everything herself.)

TextContext.SourceString: 找队员分摊一下能更快解决吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wouldn't it be easier to share this work amongst several people?

TextContext.SourceString: 团队的效率或许远大于个人，但是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: A team surely works faster than a single person, but...

TextContext.SourceString: 这是我作为队长的责任，为将先行，必成表率。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is my responsibility as a captain. I should lead by example.

TextContext.SourceString: 一个人承担这种量级的工作也太辛苦了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This work is too much for one person.

TextContext.SourceString: 这是队长必须要做的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a captain's duty.

TextContext.SourceString: 以身作则，率先垂范——这是我的责任。
TextContext.LocalizedString: One must inspire others by taking the initiative.

TextContext.SourceString: 这次不能像上次那样接待你了……记得先把物资清单填好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sorry I can't host you like usual... but make sure you fill out the requisition sheet.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇继续投身到工作中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine continues to devote herself to the paperwork.)

TextContext.SourceString: （文件堆中掉出了几份零散的战斗总结，被拉薇标上了“不予通过”的字迹。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Several battle reports marked “rejected” fall out of the pile of documents.)

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎是出自性格各异的执行者。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looks like this executor has a different style.)

TextContext.SourceString: 4月15日（划掉），4月16日……在89区（划掉），在88区……成功在爆破地点埋设了炸弹。
TextContext.LocalizedString: April 15 (crossed out), April 16... Area 89 (crossed out), Area 88... bombs successfully played at the demolition site.

TextContext.SourceString: 欧拉港口的海风吹着很舒服呢，最喜欢去那里执行任务了！拉薇队长，下次任务我们还去那里吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The sea breeze at Port Euler is wonderful. Definitely the best place to carry out a mission! Let’s go there on our next one, Captain Lawine!

TextContext.SourceString: 4月16日，88区爆破，运势凶：迷路了一上午，原来任务地点不在音像店吗？买了一张最新的流行唱片希望能转转运。
TextContext.LocalizedString: April 16, Area 88 demolition, poor fortune: I was lost all morning. Turns out the objective wasn't in the video store? I bought one of Kanami's new records to try and turn things around.

TextContext.SourceString: 5月3日，风曳镇突袭，运势凶：唉，破片手雷怎么和治疗雷长得那么像？还好有香奈美的唱片治愈着我，马上我就能转运了吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: May 3, Windy Town assault, poor fortune: Why do frag grenades look so similar to healing mines? At least I have Kanami's record to keep me company. Hoping for my luck to change soon.

TextContext.SourceString: 6月1日，救援任务，运势不详：反正还是会迷路……去听了香奈美的演唱会现场，相信那道光，追逐那道光，愈发坚信总有一天会转运的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: June 1, rescue mission, unclear fortune: I got lost again, so I went to Kanami's concert. Believe in that light, chase that light, and keep believing that things will turn around one day!

TextContext.SourceString: 6月16日，欧拉港口爆破，运势大吉：爆破任务和握手会安排在了同一地点，哈哈，终于转运了！这一次完全没有迷路！
TextContext.LocalizedString: June 16, Port Euler demolition, good fortune: The demolition mission and fan meetup happened to be right next to each other! Finally, some good luck... I didn't even get lost once!

TextContext.SourceString: ——这就是偶像带给我的好运！（最后这几个字似乎闪烁着金光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...This is the good luck my idol brings to me! (The last few words seem to be sparkling with gold dust.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，引航者，有几份要修订的总结报告不见了，你有看到么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, a few reports that need to be revised are missing. Have you seen them?

TextContext.SourceString: 是指这些“不予通过”的报告？写得真叫人头疼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You mean these “rejected” reports? I'm getting a headache just reading them.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以我才要打回订正，战场之事非同小可。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's why they need to be revised. We can't take our battlefield operations so lightly.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，真是集合奇思的文字，我正在用心品鉴。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm... what a wonderful collection of words. I'm taking my time to appreciate them carefully.

TextContext.SourceString: 倒也不必，这三份报告我都要重新订正。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No need for that. I'll be revising these reports myself.

TextContext.SourceString: 写报告不是写日记，显然个别人“用力过猛”了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A report is not meant to be a diary. Clearly, they've gotten lost in the weeds.

TextContext.SourceString: 先前的战斗我们有过不小的失误，队员们反复在一个泥潭里打滚，还有同伴因此受伤。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We made quite a few mistakes in our last battle. The team ended up in a sticky situation and suffered injuries as a result.

TextContext.SourceString: 认真做好战术总结，吸取教训，就不会发生这种事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As long as we carefully consider our tactics and learn from our mistakes, this kind of thing won't happen again.

TextContext.SourceString: （不出几分钟，拉薇就改好了三份战斗总结，修订后的版本终于有了战术报告的模样。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the span of just a few minutes, Lawine manages to revise the battle reports into something more useful.)

TextContext.SourceString: 好、好快！
TextContext.LocalizedString: S-So fast!

TextContext.SourceString: 已经完成了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you done already?

TextContext.SourceString: 原本就不是很难写的东西，只是有人在偷懒罢了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is not difficult work. As you can see, some people are just lazy.

TextContext.SourceString: 之前是我没有做好表率，忽略了这方面的工作。果然领头者不亲力亲为，手底下的人也会浑浑噩噩。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was careless and neglected this part of our work. Sure enough, if the leader doesn't set an example, their subordinates won't know what to do.

TextContext.SourceString: 我还在欧泊带队的时候就吃到过这种教训。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I learned this lesson when I was a PUS squad leader.

TextContext.SourceString: 预计不到一个小时就能处理完这批工作了，等会儿我带你到仓库提取物资。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The rest of this will take around an hour to complete. Once I'm done, I'll take you to the warehouse to pick up your supplies.

TextContext.SourceString: （对拉薇的效率表示震惊。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Express shock at Lawine's efficiency.)

TextContext.SourceString: （对拉薇的效率发出赞赏。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Compliment Lawine's efficiency.)

TextContext.SourceString: 其疾如风，动如雷霆——唯有凭借这种速度，面对欧泊的战士们，我们才有获胜的可能。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Swift as the wind and agile as thunder... this is the speed we need to defeat P.U.S.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇又低头翻阅了下手边的文件。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine lowers her head to the papers in front of her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……应该还能更快，积攒的工作远比我想的要简单。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mmm... I should be able to go faster. There are more ways to save time than I expected.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，请再稍等片刻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, please wait a moment.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇眼睛迸发出火花，那眼神如同拔刀的武者一般坚定。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With sparks coming out of her eyes, Lawine's gaze was as firm as a warrior drawing their weapon.)

TextContext.SourceString: （纸堆砌成的小山被一把无形之刀迅速切开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The mountain of papers disappears, as if cut through by an invisible blade.)

TextContext.SourceString: （大概就分了一会儿神，最后看到拉薇的时候，她将最后一份文件归整到文件夹内。那动作如同收刀一般平稳。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I must have drifted off... When Lawine came into view again, she was organizing the final document into a folder, her movements smooth, as if sheathing her blade.)

TextContext.SourceString: （之后，带着填好的物资清单，跟随拉薇到仓库中取了所需的物资。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Afterwards, holding the filled-in requisition sheet, I accompany Lawine to the warehouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: （得知拉薇受伤的消息，出于担心，赶往她的住所探望。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having learned about Lawine's injury, I rush to her dorm to see her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （左右张望，没有看到拉薇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I look left and right, but don't see Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在房间门口稍候了片刻。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I wait a moment by the door.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……这么晚了，有事么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...It's late. What's the matter?

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇出现了，还是身着那身素白的衣服。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine appears by the door dressed in her old plain white clothes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别站在这儿了，我们进去说吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's talk inside.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇打开了房门。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine opens the door.)

TextContext.SourceString: （留意到拉薇带着一个包裹回来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I notice that she's holding a package.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你问这个么？是前几天预订的吊兰种子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This thing? They're the spider plant seeds I ordered a few days ago.

TextContext.SourceString: 等到花盆和土壤也到了，我打算种种看。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Once the pots and soil arrive, I'll plant some of them.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇放下包裹的时候，看到了衣袖遮挡下的绷带。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine places the package down, revealing the bandage hidden by her sleeve.)

TextContext.SourceString: 听说你受伤了，现在怎么样了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I heard you were injured. How are you holding up?

TextContext.SourceString: 一点小伤，没什么大碍。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's just a flesh wound. No big deal.

TextContext.SourceString: ……你就为了这个而特意过来的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Did you come here just for this?

TextContext.SourceString: 只是没想到拉薇这样的身手也会……
TextContext.LocalizedString: With your skills, I didn't expect...

TextContext.SourceString: 为组织稍稍冒了点险而已。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I took a small risk in performing my duties, that's all.

TextContext.SourceString: 原先我打探到了一条情报，有一批提纯晶体从欧泊秘密流出。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I got a report that the PUS was making a secret shipment of purified crystals.

TextContext.SourceString: 于是我跟着那几个情报贩子亲自前往运输地点，核实情报的真实性。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, I followed our source to the transport site to verify the truth of the report.

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊的确在暗中运输提纯晶体，但在我搞定了欧泊的人以后，情报贩子却立即跳反。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The report of the secret shipment was true, but once I got rid of the P.U.S guards, the source turned on me.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是想黑吃黑啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: They were trying to get you to take each other out!

TextContext.SourceString: 他们也在打晶体的主意？
TextContext.LocalizedString: They were also after the crystals?

TextContext.SourceString: 不错，他们是想借我之手清除掉截获晶体的威胁，事成之后再把我也一并解决。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Indeed. They planned to use me to get rid of the guards, then turn on me while I was weak to take the crystals all for themselves.

TextContext.SourceString: 但我可不会让他们如愿以偿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I wasn't going to let them win that easily!

TextContext.SourceString: 他们最好牢牢记住脉冲刀的滋味。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They best remember the feeling of my pulse blade on their skin.

TextContext.SourceString: （说到这里时，拉薇的眼神凌厉如刀锋。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine's glare was as sharp as a blade)

TextContext.SourceString: 不过以少胜多还是有些……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Still, they did end up getting in a few...
Ugh!

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇突然捂住了受伤的胳膊。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine suddenly puts a hand over her injured arm.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像滴了一滴墨，鲜血迅速染红了洁白的绷带，形成了一小滩血迹。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Like drops of ink, her blood has pooled into a patch on her bandage.)

TextContext.SourceString: 无事，我确认了一下，只是伤口渗血了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm fine. The wound is just bleeding a little.

TextContext.SourceString: 出血量不多，过一会儿血就能自动止住。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's not much. The blood will clot soon enough.

TextContext.SourceString: 保险起见，还是检查一下伤口吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me take a look at the wound, just to be safe.

TextContext.SourceString: 那样太耽误时间了，简单处理就行。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's too much of a hassle. This way is fine.

TextContext.SourceString: 算了一下也该到换药的时候了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It should be time to change the dressing, anyway.

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇家里应该有医疗箱什么的吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you have a medkit around?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，备了一个，主要用来处理外伤的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I do, but it's mostly for minor injuries.

TextContext.SourceString: 正好，我也该给伤口换药了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It should suffice.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇拿出了一个小而白的纳药箱。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine produces a small white medkit.)

TextContext.SourceString: （里面备齐了各种常见的医疗用品，特别是应对外伤的药物，酒精、绷带也准备了好几份。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's fully stocked with a variety of common medical supplies, along with a bunch of rubbing alcohol and bandages.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她从药箱里取出了绷带和酒精。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine removes the rubbing alcohol and a fresh bandage.)

TextContext.SourceString: 真是麻烦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Such a hassle!

TextContext.SourceString: （看到拉薇强忍着疼痛，艰难地解开血染的绷带。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine holds back her pain as she struggles to untie the blood-stained bandage.)

TextContext.SourceString: （很明显……仅靠一个人是很难处理伤口的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Clearly... it's not that easy to treat a wound by yourself.)

TextContext.SourceString: 让我来帮你吧，姑且我也是星庇所的医生喔。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me help. I'm also a doctor at the Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: ……星庇所？听说是一家收纳和救治崩溃症患者的医疗机构。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...The Astral Sanctuary? Isn't that the place that treats patients with collapse syndrome?

TextContext.SourceString: 原来你在那里任职么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So that's where you work...?

TextContext.SourceString: （准备走上前的时候，被拉薇拦下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just as I was about to step forward, Lawine stoped me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你的好意我心领了，我自己来就行，处理外伤我比较有经验。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you for your kindness, but I can do it myself. I have more experience treating wounds.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇继续尝试解开绷带，似乎绷带和伤口粘在一起了，扯不下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine continues trying to untie the bandage, but it seems to have gotten stuck on the wound.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……啧，还是不行……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Tsk. It's not coming off...

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然拉薇只是用余光微微一瞥，但还是捕捉到了她求助的目光……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine shoots me a look out of the corner of her eye. This must be her way of asking for help...)

TextContext.SourceString: （协助拉薇给伤口换药。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Help Lawine dress her wound.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……稍微遇到了些麻烦，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Apologies for the trouble, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 你能帮我拿些活性碘么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could you bring me the active iodine?

TextContext.SourceString: （与拉薇保持了一定距离，递给她需要的药品。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Keeping some distance from Lawine, I hand her the requested item.)

TextContext.SourceString: （涂抹上药剂后，纱布顺利地撕掉了，一道很深的伤口暴露在外。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine applies the medicine, then tears off the gauze in a smooth motion, revealing a deep wound beneath.)

TextContext.SourceString: （尽管稍微花了些时间，拉薇还是勉强给伤口换完了药。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With much effort, Lawine eventually manages to dress her wound.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，伤口状况良好，果然只是少量渗血。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hm. The wound is recovering nicely. As expected, there was only a small amount of bleeding.

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到你对常见的外伤药也很熟悉，药品给得很及时，帮了大忙了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't expect you to be so familiar with first aid. Your assistance was a great help.

TextContext.SourceString: （亲自为拉薇换药。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Dress Lawine's wound yourself.)

TextContext.SourceString: （还是走上前帮助拉薇解开绷带。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I push forward to untie Lawine's bandage on my own.)

TextContext.SourceString: （使用活性碘分离了粘连的绷带和伤口。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I grab some activated iodine and use it to separate the adhesive bandage from her wound.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一道很深的伤口暴露在外，如果不是战斗的时候非常拼命不会留下这样的伤口。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The bandage falls to the wayside, revealing a deep gash. It must have been a desperate battle.)

TextContext.SourceString: （确认了伤口没有化脓，只是少量渗血。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looking over, I confirm that there's no pus, only a little blood.)

TextContext.SourceString: （两个人的距离第一次如此近，拉薇没怎么说话，似乎不太习惯这个距离。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We have never been so close before. Lawine remains silent, uncomfortable with the distance.)

TextContext.SourceString: （很顺利地帮拉薇换完了药。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I finish dressing her wound in no time.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，血已经止住了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Looks like the bleeding has stopped.

TextContext.SourceString: ……谢了，伤口处理得很干净，没想到你对处理外伤也那么在行。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...The wound was treated very well. You have my thanks. I didn't expect you to be so good at first aid.

TextContext.SourceString: （很在意拉薇受伤的事情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Worry over her injury.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她在那次任务中……似乎到了不顾及性命的地步。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (During that mission... it's as if she had no regard for her own life at all.)

TextContext.SourceString: 执行任务时……为什么要做到这种程度呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: When performing your missions... do you really have to take things so far?

TextContext.SourceString: 不需要什么特别的理由。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's no special reason.

TextContext.SourceString: 为了组织当然就要做到最好，一柄刀如果在战斗中不能尽显锋锐，它就毫无价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: For the sake of The Scissors, I have to do my best. A sharp blade that remains sheathed is of no use to anyone.

TextContext.SourceString: （“滴答”——拉薇的手机响了一声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (“Ring, ring...” Lawine's phone goes off.)

TextContext.SourceString: 又有新的作战任务了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Another combat mission...

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，引航者，我该动身了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Apologies, Navigator. I have to go.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天的事情多谢了，如果没有你，可能就要耽误下一次的任务了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you very much for your help today. If it wasn't for you, this mission might have been delayed.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天见面仓促招待不周，改天安排会面的话，我们再来一起喝杯热茶吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Today's meeting was rushed, and I could not host you properly. The next time we see each other, let's enjoy a cup of hot tea.

TextContext.SourceString: （尝试劝说拉薇继续休养，但显然她不会回头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I try to convince Lawine to rest until the wound heals, but she doesn't look back.)

TextContext.SourceString: （意识到拉薇对待敌人的这份冷酷同样也是在对待自己。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She treats herself with the same coldness she directs at her enemies.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在夜色中默默地目送着她离开了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can only watch as she disappears silently into the night.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在赫尔墨斯预订的游戏机和卡带到货了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The console and game cartridges I ordered from Hermes have finally arrived.)

TextContext.SourceString: （使用通行凭证离开了基地，但被告知外出时不能暴露自己的身份。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I used my pass to leave the base, but not before being warned to keep my identity hidden from the outside world.)

TextContext.SourceString: （于是随身带了一顶帽子和一副墨镜用作伪装。它们是某次商场大减价购入的，防晒性能却十分良好。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This hat and pair of sunglasses are my disguise. I got them at a sale, but they've proven useful for keeping the sun at bay.)

TextContext.SourceString: （日常的街道，一如既往地平静安宁，很怀念这种久违的感觉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The streets are as calm and peaceful as I remember. I've missed the feeling of being out like this.)

TextContext.SourceString: （突然听到身后一阵紧促的脚步声不断逼近……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hear sudden, hurried footsteps approaching from behind...)

TextContext.SourceString: （转身一看，瞥见了熟悉的身影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I turn around and see a familiar person.)

TextContext.SourceString: （呼喊拉薇的名字。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Call out Lawine's name.)

TextContext.SourceString: （向拉薇挥挥手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wave to Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是你……今天为什么是这副打扮？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's you... but why are you dressed up like that?

TextContext.SourceString: （意外地遇见了身着作战服的拉薇，此时的她尤为警觉地扫视着四周。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I unexpectedly ran into Lawine in full combat attire, busy scanning our surroundings with great vigilance.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……你似乎在躲着什么人？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Are you hiding from someone?

TextContext.SourceString: 说来话长了，跟我到这里来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a long story. Follow me.

TextContext.SourceString: （跟着拉薇来到一处隐蔽的街角。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I follow Lawine into a secluded corner.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我刚刚结束一次作战行动。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I just finished a combat operation.

TextContext.SourceString: 这次的收获非常丰厚，我们成功截获了不少高纯度晶体。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This one was a great success. We managed to intercept a number of high-purity crystals.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是相应地也招来了不小的麻烦，欧泊的搜查官正在四处稽查我们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, P.U.S is bringing down the hammer. They've got investigators combing this place for signs of our activity.

TextContext.SourceString: 那可不妙啊，拉薇还是赶快回基地去吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How dangerous! You should return to base as soon as possible.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我也是为了保证下属安全撤离，才滞留在欧泊的地盘上的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah. I've been staying behind to make sure everyone gets out.

TextContext.SourceString: 趁搜查官们还没有赶到，差不多我也该——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before the investigators arrive, I should probably make my...

TextContext.SourceString: 我刚刚好像听到了“她”的声音！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think I just heard “her” voice!

TextContext.SourceString: （大量搜查官陆续涌现，跟随在一名少女长官的背后。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A party of investigators enters the area, following behind a young captain.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我们就是在这条街上跟丢了她，继续搜查，不能放过任何可疑人等。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is where we lost her. Search the place, and don't let anyone suspicious escape.

TextContext.SourceString: 剪刀手的“拉薇”……这次，别想从我手中溜走！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lawine... You're not getting away this time!

TextContext.SourceString: 啧，那帮家伙还是“嗅着”味道追过来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tsk. Looks like they caught on to my scent.

TextContext.SourceString: ——为什么她也在？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...What's she doing here?

TextContext.SourceString: （或错愕，或伤悲，犹如被一阵阴霾笼罩，从来没有见到过拉薇流露出这样的神情……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I've never seen this expression on Lawine's face before. She looked sorrowful, stunned, lost in a haze.)

TextContext.SourceString: （原本打算撤离的她却手足无措地呆立在原地。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine's feet seemed to be locked in place.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那边那两位，请停下脚步接受欧泊搜查局的调查！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You two over there! Submit yourself to the Sentinel Bureau's inspection!

TextContext.SourceString: （搜查官们还是发现了这里，眼看着他们就要不断逼近……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The investigators had found us. Their footsteps were approaching...)

TextContext.SourceString: （轻唤拉薇的名字。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Softly call out Lawine's name.)

TextContext.SourceString: （拍拍拉薇的肩膀。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Pat Lawine on the shoulder.)

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，走神了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry, I got distracted...

TextContext.SourceString: 你赶快走，不用管我，我自有办法脱身。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Get out of here. Don't worry about me - I'll find a way to escape.

TextContext.SourceString: （烦恼地挠了挠头，刚好摸到了头顶打折买的贝雷帽。脑内灵光一现，有了！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Scratching my head, I feel the beret I bought on sale. I've got an idea!)

TextContext.SourceString: （给拉薇戴上墨镜和帽子。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I put a pair of sunglasses and a hat on Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你说用这个……能躲避搜查官追查？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you saying... they can help me avoid the investigators?

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然拉薇脸上写满了难以置信，但还是配合着做好了伪装。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Filled with disbelief, Lawine lets me put the disguise on her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （超大号的墨镜刚好能遮住拉薇的半脸，容量充足的帽子也能完全收住她碧蓝的长发。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The oversized sunglasses cover half of Lawine's face while the large hat hides her long azure hair.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……那姑且就和你赌一把吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Alright, I'll take the bet.

TextContext.SourceString: （很好奇在帽子和墨镜下此时的她是怎样的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I'm curious about her expression under the hat and sunglasses.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这一次两个人距离都很近，能够听见彼此的呼吸。能感觉到拉薇也一样地紧张。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Standing close to Lawine, I can hear her breathing as she can hear mine. Both of us are equally nervous.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你们有看到照片中的这个人么？她是剪刀手的执行者“拉薇”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: See the person in the photo? That's Lawine, the Executor of The Scissors.

TextContext.SourceString: 她是我们正在追击的要犯，这一带有她活动的痕迹，有任何相关信息请务必告知我们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She is our most wanted fugitive. Evidence suggests that she is active in this area. If you see or hear anything about her, please inform me immediately.

TextContext.SourceString: （很自然地摇头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I shake my head naturally.)

TextContext.SourceString: （耸耸肩，表示一无所知。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I shrug my shoulders, indicating that I don't know anything about this person.)

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？完全没见过吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? You've never seen her?

TextContext.SourceString: 呃……你这位同伴是怎么回事？为什么把自己捂得那么严实？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh... What's wrong with your friend? Why is she all covered up?

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，你说你是星庇所的医生，而她是你们的急诊患者……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait. You're telling me you're a doctor from Astral Sanctuary, and she's an ER patient?

TextContext.SourceString: 讲述一个关于绝望医患互相拯救的故事
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell a story about a doctor and patient desperately trying to save another

TextContext.SourceString: （于是即兴讲述了这样一个故事……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I improvise such a story...)

TextContext.SourceString: （曾经有一位不受任何人重视的绝望医生，遇见了另一位被病痛折磨的绝望患者……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A desperate doctor, overlooked by everyone, meets an equally demoralized patient, tormented by illness...)

TextContext.SourceString: （后来，为了拯救这位患者，医生赌上了自己的一切，愿意倾其所有……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Afterward, in order to save the patient, the doctor bets everything on her, willing to give it her all...)

TextContext.SourceString: （面对这对曲折离奇的病患，在场的搜查官无一不声泪俱下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hearing a bizarre and twisted story about the pair, the investigators present are all moved to tears.)

TextContext.SourceString: 原来你们之间曾经发生过这样的事情……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your story is fascinating...

TextContext.SourceString: 讲述一个怕光者想要重见阳光的励志故事
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell an inspirational story of a photophobic patient wanting to feel the sunlight

TextContext.SourceString: （于是即兴讲述了这样一个故事……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I improvise such a story...)

TextContext.SourceString: （向往阳光是生物的本能，但是阳光对于她却美好得可怕。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's only natural for living beings to long for sunlight. But for her, it's terrifyingly beautiful.)

TextContext.SourceString: （无数次、无数次地，饱受着烈焰的灼烧，她像飞蛾一般扑向太阳。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Time and time again, she embraces the sun like a moth to a flame, suffering the scorching heat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （正是这份脆弱生命苦苦抗争的美打动了在场的每一个人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The desperate struggle of a fragile life touches everyone present.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……无比向往阳光却又无法直视，所以才要打扮成这样出门的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Longing for the sun yet unable to gaze at it. Is that why she's dressed this way?

TextContext.SourceString: 咳、咳！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (cough)

TextContext.SourceString: （可能是被捂得太严实了，拉薇忍不住咳了几声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine can't help but cough, possibly as a result of being all covered up.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不要紧吧？刚刚有说过是急诊患者，是很严重的情况吧，那还是不要耽误了，赶快送诊吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is she ok? You said she was an ER patient, so it must be serious, right? Go on, then. Take her to the hospital!

TextContext.SourceString: 未能发现嫌疑人的踪迹！事不宜迟，我们即刻前往其他街区继续搜查！
TextContext.LocalizedString: There are no traces of the suspect! Let's go. We need to search other areas!

TextContext.SourceString: （蓝白制服的搜查官陆陆续续散开了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The investigators in their blue and white uniforms leave us.)

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇再三确认后才卸下了伪装，跟着她另找了一处隐蔽点。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine double-checks to make sure all the investigators are gone before removing her disguise. She takes me to another hiding spot.)

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳……帽子上似乎有一股刺鼻的味道。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (cough) The hat has a pungent smell.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，抱歉，真是辛苦了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, sorry about that. It must've been unpleasant.

TextContext.SourceString: （一想到是个打折货，内心产生了一些愧疚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Realizing that I bought the hat on sale, I feel guilty.)

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么要道歉呢……幸亏有你帮了我，我才终于摆脱了那帮搜查官。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't apologize. Thanks to you, I've finally gotten rid of the investigators.

TextContext.SourceString: 这次，是我欠你一个人情……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I owe you one...

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇望向那个女孩离去的方向。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine looks in the direction the girl had left.)

TextContext.SourceString: 话说回来，那名搜查官还挺热心的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That investigator seemed to be quite good-hearted.

TextContext.SourceString: 热心……？曾经我也是这么觉得的，天底下怎么会有这么好心的笨蛋。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good-hearted... I used to think so as well. How could there be such a kind fool?

TextContext.SourceString: （提到那名搜查官时，拉薇的语气却变得有些忧伤。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Mentioning the investigator, Lawine sounds slightly sad.)

TextContext.SourceString: 但她和他们到底是一样的，都是些虚伪的善良。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But in the end, she's exactly like them. A bunch of hypocrites.

TextContext.SourceString: 换作是普雷顿的难民们，她就像他们一样弃之不顾，置若罔闻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If they were refugees from Preton, she would have left them all alone, pretending to be unaware.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个人是拉薇的朋友么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is she a friend of yours?

TextContext.SourceString: ……是曾经的朋友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Used to be.

TextContext.SourceString: 你似乎认识那个人？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you know her?

TextContext.SourceString: 对，她曾是我在欧泊的搭档。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, she was my partner back at PUS.

TextContext.SourceString: 那时候她还是个以“出人意料”著称的热心肠……不得不说，和你有些相像。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She was unknown for her unexpected warm-heartedness... A bit like you, now that I think about it.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在……已经完全变成另一个人了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But now... she's become a completely different person.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇不愿过多提及到那位故人，很快终止了话题。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Not wanting to discuss her former friend, Lawine changes the subject.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她低头沉默了片刻，似乎想到了什么。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looking down in silence for a couple of seconds, she seems to have remembered something.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，你今天出门是有什么事要忙吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't you have things to take care of?

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是去拿预定好的货物么？顺路的话就一起吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were going to pick up some goods, right? I'm happy to come with you if you don't mind.

TextContext.SourceString: （由于担心引来其他的麻烦，提议把帽子和太阳镜一人分一个进行伪装。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Concerned about our identities being exposed, I suggest we split the hat and sunglasses between us.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就这样两个人以一种特别的装扮取到了货物。虽然依旧抗拒这种伪装，拉薇的心情却意外地不错。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In our unique disguises, we manage to pick up the goods. Although she's still not used to her disguise, Lawine is in surprisingly good spirits.)

TextContext.SourceString: （最后和拉薇一起返回了基地，在回去的路上约定了第四次见面。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On the way back to the base, Lawine and I agree to meet again for the fourth time.)

TextContext.SourceString: （晚风习习，乘着夜色来到与拉薇约定的茶社。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Under the gentle evening breeze, I arrive at the teahouse where I had agreed to meet Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在庭院外能依稀听闻竹林摆动的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Outside the courtyard, I hear the faint sound of bamboo swaying in the wind.)

TextContext.SourceString: （步入茶社，拉薇已经等候多时了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I step into the teahouse, I realize that Lawine has been waiting for me for quite some time.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你来了啊，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're here, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然身着作战服，拉薇却没有表现得很警惕。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Although dressed in her combat suit, Lawine does not appear to be on alert.)

TextContext.SourceString: 放心，这家茶社很安全，老板是我的熟人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Relax. This is a safe place. The owner is a friend.

TextContext.SourceString: （暂时舒了一口气，注意到拉薇面色忧虑，与清净的茶社不大协调。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Breathing a sigh of relief, I notice that Lawine looks worried, seemingly out of place in the serene teahouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: 说起来……上次你帮我的事，非常感谢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... Thanks for helping me last time.

TextContext.SourceString: 我家里是开设武馆的，我们习惯通过武艺传达意图和想法。所以，我以自己的方式准备了一份谢礼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: My family runs a dojo. We are accustomed to expressing our intentions and thoughts through martial arts. Therefore, I've prepared a gift in my own way.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇不知从哪里亮出了一把木制匕首。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine produces a wooden dagger from seemingly nowhere.)

TextContext.SourceString: （刀身历经了岁月沧桑，但经过精心的保养依旧光泽饱满。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Despite showing signs of wear, the blade gleams as a result of proper maintenance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 过去我一直跟随父亲修习刀术，从他那里继承过来了这种短刀流派。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Growing up, I learned swordsmanship under my father, who passed to me this style of dagger technique.

TextContext.SourceString: 作为报答，我想把家里的刀术传授给你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I would like to teach it to you as a token of my appreciation.

TextContext.SourceString: 这么说我也能成为传说中的“大侠”了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Does that mean I can become a hero as well?

TextContext.SourceString: 这就要看你的资质与悟性了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you've got what it takes, yes.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然对于你，我还是有所期待的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, I have high expectations of you.

TextContext.SourceString: 对即将学习的武功表示跃跃欲试。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Show interest in learning martial arts.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，你有兴致就好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good. As long as you're interested.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过作为初学者，要做好应对大量枯燥训练的准备。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a beginner, you have to be prepared for monotonous training.

TextContext.SourceString: （正说着，又一把锋利的匕首出鞘，刀尖鲜红。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As she speaks, she unsheathes another sharp dagger with a bright red tip.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不必惊讶，“利用形彰，切以道隐”是匕首的最大特点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The greatest characteristics of the dagger are its sharp edge and its ability to be hidden.

TextContext.SourceString: 在发起攻击前，武者不会轻易将匕首的位置暴露给敌人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before attacking, a warrior does not reveal to the enemy the position of their dagger.

TextContext.SourceString: 多说无用，我们开始吧，先从如何握刀学起。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enough talk. Let's practice with the real thing, beginning with how to hold the dagger.

TextContext.SourceString: 对于初学者，我推荐正握匕首，就像这样……
TextContext.LocalizedString: For a beginner like yourself, I recommend a forward grip. Like this...

TextContext.SourceString: （跟随着拉薇，纠正了自己行凶抢劫一般的拿刀姿势……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Following Lawine's instruction, I change the way I hold the dagger, no longer looking like a common thug...)

TextContext.SourceString: （之后又向拉薇学了几套基础的匕首招式。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Afterward, Lawine teaches me a few basic dagger techniques.)

TextContext.SourceString: 掌握得不错，来检验一下训练成果吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not bad. Let's see if you can put it into practice.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然我会把握分寸的，以武会友，我们点到为止。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll go easy on you. No one has to get hurt.

TextContext.SourceString: 放马过来吧，现在的我状态绝佳。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bring it on. I'm feeling great.

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇老师，望不吝赐教。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please go easy on me, Lawine.

TextContext.SourceString: （短暂的寒暄过后，匕首在拉薇的手中翻飞——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a brief exchange, Lawine swings her dagger.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但仅仅一眨眼的工夫……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But in the blink of an eye...)

TextContext.SourceString: （匕首就逼近了眼前！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her dagger is closing in on me!)

TextContext.SourceString: 突然一个背身而站，挺拔如松
TextContext.LocalizedString: Suddenly stand up, straight as a pine

TextContext.SourceString: （突然的背身让拉薇高度警觉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My sudden move puts Lawine on high alert.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她本能地退后一步，仿佛下一秒对方就要施展非常厉害的武功绝学。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She instinctively steps back, as if expecting me to unleash a powerful move.)

TextContext.SourceString: 猛然一下席地而坐，端正如钟
TextContext.LocalizedString: Suddenly sit down, upright as a clock

TextContext.SourceString: （突然坐下让拉薇尤为困惑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My move confuses Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她迅速收刀，极为谨慎地观察着眼前的形势。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She quickly sheathes her dagger, carefully observing the situation.)

TextContext.SourceString: （无人进，亦无人退，这样的局面僵持了良久。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (No one dares to make a move, resulting in a lasting stalemate.)
...Tsk.

TextContext.SourceString: （一时之间，拉薇陷入了苦思。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (For a moment, Lawine is lost in thought.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是马上她又发动了新一轮的攻击。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But then, she launches another round of attack.)

TextContext.SourceString: （匕首在她的手中如同一道迅猛的闪电。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The dagger moves as a swift flash of lightning in her hand.)

TextContext.SourceString: 侧身闪躲
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sidestep the strike

TextContext.SourceString: （勉强躲开了拉薇的出招，没有因为拉薇的攻势而乱了阵脚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I barely manage to dodge Lawine's attack, maintaining my balance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 绕到身后
TextContext.LocalizedString: Get behind her

TextContext.SourceString: （尝试着绕到拉薇的身后，但自己的动向还是被拉薇察觉到了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I try to get behind her, but she sees through my intention.)

TextContext.SourceString: （只见她调整了攻势，被她瞬间限制住了移动范围，如陷囹圄。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Adjusting her stance, Lawine restricts my range of movement, trapping me where I stand.)

TextContext.SourceString: （等待着拉薇的下一步动作……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I wait for Lawine to make her next move...)

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎什么都没有发生。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Nothing seems to happen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那股进攻的意志仿佛熄灭了一般，匕首在她手中翻转了一圈后归入了鞘中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She spins her dagger before sheathing it as if she's lost the will to attack.)

TextContext.SourceString: 发生什么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What happened?

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇，你还好么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you alright, Lawine?

TextContext.SourceString: 啧，居然在基础招式的对练中分神了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tsk, I got distracted in practice...

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，明明是我主动发起的对练，我却没能认真对待。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Apologies. I failed to take seriously the training session I initiated.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇挣扎着想再次出招，然而，就像上次面对那名搜查官一样，她忽然变得手足无措。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine struggles to strike again. However, just like when she faced the investigator, she becomes flustered all of a sudden.)

TextContext.SourceString: （终于，她还是放弃了……带着话语中满满的不甘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the end, she gives up, with great reluctance in her speech.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是我输了，引航者……你的表现更胜一筹。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I lost, Navigator... You have bested me.

TextContext.SourceString: 作为初学者，你能够从容沉稳地招架我的进攻，你究竟是……使用了什么样的战术？
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a beginner, you were able to parry my attacks with ease... What kind of tactics did you utilize?

TextContext.SourceString: 是武学中的最高境界——“心理战术”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The best of them all - psychological tactics!

TextContext.SourceString: 这招叫做“以不变应万变”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is a martial arts technique called “responding to endless changes with constancy.”

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇似乎倍感惊讶。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine seems surprised.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……原来如此。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I see.

TextContext.SourceString: 心若止水，不动如山……一个新人尚能如此，果然现在的我还是差得太远了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: To be as still as water, as immovable as a mountain. You managed to achieve this as a mere beginner... I still have a long way to go...

TextContext.SourceString: 我的修行仍旧不够、远远不够……我还不够强。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have trained far from enough... I still lack strength.

TextContext.SourceString: （她垂下头不停地念叨着那句话，仿佛是对自己的提醒与责罚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lower her head, she mutters that phrase as if to remind and punish herself.)

TextContext.SourceString: （无论如何都想要变得强大……非常好奇这其中的缘由。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her desire to become powerful no matter the cost... I am curious about the reason behind it.)

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇有这份变强的决心，一定有什么理由吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's the drive behind your determination to become stronger?

TextContext.SourceString: ……因为曾经和某人约定好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I once made a pact with someone.

TextContext.SourceString: 约定好了一起变得强大，一起守护这个世界上被崩溃症苦苦折磨的人们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We promised each other that we'd become stronger together and protect the people tormented by collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然，记得这个约定的人，应该只有我一个了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Although, I'm probably the only one who still remembers the pact.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇无奈地苦笑，缓缓抬起头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine lifts up her head, revealing a wry smile.)

TextContext.SourceString: （与我两眼相望时，她的眼睛变得黯淡而又迷惘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As we look at one another, her eyes become dim and confused.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那个家伙上次和我们打过照面，你对她也有印象的吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: We ran into her last time. Do you remember?

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到能再次见到她，她真的对过去的事一点都不记得了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I did not expect to see her again. She really didn't remember anything from the past.

TextContext.SourceString: 她变成现在这样……归根到底都是我不够强大，无法阻止欧泊，无法制止她的背叛……
TextContext.LocalizedString: She's become the way she is... because of my weakness. Because I couldn't stop P.U.S; because I could not prevent her from betraying us...

TextContext.SourceString: 自身的羸弱也好，犹豫也罢，我都十分清楚，我痛恨这样的自己……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm very aware of my own weakness and hesitation, and I despise myself for it...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，我一定要不停地战斗，不断地磨砺自己，唯有这样——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I must keep fighting and honing my skills, for this is the only way.

TextContext.SourceString: （或许是被内心的迷惘所困，拉薇也不知道该望向何方。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Perhaps troubled by her inner turmoil, Lawine does not know what the future holds for her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （见证过作为领袖亲力亲为的拉薇，也见证过她作为执行者时的当机立断，疾如猛火。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I have seen firsthand Lawine's down-to-earth attitude as a leader and her decisive, swift actions as an executor.)

TextContext.SourceString: （无法认同她对自己的这番评价，决定再一次和拉薇对练。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Disagreeing with the conclusion of her self-assessment, I ask to spar with Lawine again.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这一次，请全力攻过来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please don't hold back this time!
You...

TextContext.SourceString: （起初还略微困惑，但在二人目光相接后……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She seems slightly confused at the beginning, but as our eyes lock...)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我明白了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I understand now.

TextContext.SourceString: （她的目光骤然变得犀利如刀，就像初见她的时候。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her gaze becomes as sharp as a knife, just like when we first met.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这一次她似乎没有迷茫，刀锋乘着清风挥舞，无比干净利落。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (No longer confused, she swings her dagger with great precision, as if dancing in the wind.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一招之内就被拉薇定住了身，无法动弹。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine manages to defeat me with a single move.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哎呀呀，是我输了呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alas, I lost.

TextContext.SourceString: 果然这才是拉薇的实力啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is Lawine's true strength.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇作为获胜的一方也有些吃惊。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The victor Lawine appears surprised.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……该怎么说呢，可能是因为受到了你的指点吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How do I put this... Your tips probably helped.

TextContext.SourceString: 心里想着你所使用的那种“特别战术”，身体就不由自主地跟着动了，刀在那一瞬间也变得无比轻盈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thinking of the special tactics you told me about, my body seemingly moved on its own, and the dagger felt incredibly light.

TextContext.SourceString: 果真很畅快呢，引航者，很久没有找到这种心境了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That was fun, Navigator. It's been a while since I've felt this way.

TextContext.SourceString: 我认识的拉薇其实是个强得可怕的家伙喔——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Lawine I know is a formidable opponent.

TextContext.SourceString: 希望你不要一直受到那些事情的影响。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hope you'll stop being affected by past events.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，或许我还不知道该如何处理与她相关的事……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps I do not yet know how to deal with things related to her...

TextContext.SourceString: 但是这一次过后，再次面对她的身影，我应该不会再手足无措了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I won't be helpless facing her again. That's for sure.

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇轻闭双眸，感受着清风拂面的感觉。她的长发同庭院的翠竹一同摇曳。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine closes her eyes, feeling the gentle breeze, her hair swaying with the bamboo in the courtyard.)

TextContext.SourceString: 今天找你对练其实是有些私心的，为了使内心平静我曾经曾不断地找人对练，大多无济于事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I confess: I had other intentions when I asked to meet you. I have sparred with a lot of people in an attempt to calm my mind but to little avail.

TextContext.SourceString: 果然……只有你才是不一样的，我现在愈发确信，你就像传闻中那样“不一般”呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're different from all of them. Now more than ever, I'm convinced that you are indeed as extraordinary as the rumors say.

TextContext.SourceString: 尽管是我传授你武艺，但是从某种程度上你对我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: While I taught you martial arts, in a way, you have...

TextContext.SourceString: （“滴答”——一条突如其来的简讯打断了拉薇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Beep! A text message interrupts Lawine.)

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，引航者，是很紧急的集合号令，一群结党营私的混混盯上了我们在普雷顿的平民避难所……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me, Navigator. It's an urgent assembly order. A group of gangsters is targeting the shelter in Preton...

TextContext.SourceString: 快去吧，现在正是大家需要你的时候。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Go on, then. They need you.

TextContext.SourceString: 请一定多加小心，注意不要受伤。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please be careful and don't get hurt.
Mm-hmm...

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇平静地凑过来耳语。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lawine moves closer, calmly whispering.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，下次我们还到这里相见吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's meet here again, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 对于你，我还有一些很重要的、未说完的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have important things to tell you...

TextContext.SourceString: （回过神时，拉薇已然消失在了夜色里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (By the time I realize what Lawine just said, she has also disappeared into the night.)

TextContext.SourceString: （怀揣着下次见面的约定，行走在月光洒满的道路上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Thinking of our future meeting, I walk under the moonlight.)

TextContext.SourceString: （今夜如此静好，如同拉薇终于宁静的内心一般。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The streets are quiet, just like Lawine. who has finally found inner peace.)

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，你今天来找我就是为了这个？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 不会打扰到你吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 因为我迫切需要拉薇的帮助！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然不太明白，为什么这份录像非要今天看不可……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 但我确实对战术分析很感兴趣，所以，没问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （拿出事先准备好、“动过一点手脚”的战术录像，交给了拉薇。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 上周乌尔比诺联盟旗下的组织举行了战斗演练，
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 星庇所居然只拿了第二，这怎么行！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 作为剪刀手的军师，拉薇能为我提一些建议吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，明白了，我会认真看的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （坐在沙发上，和拉薇一起观看战术录像。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （拉薇看得很认真，提出了许多中肯建议。让知道之后会发生什么的我产生了些许微妙的愧疚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （果然，在计划好的时间点，录像开始花屏，几秒后，伴随着刺耳的杂音，屏幕彻底暗了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 屏幕怎么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 机器坏了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我、我也不知道……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 这台机器虽然旧，但从没出过问题啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 没关系，你在这里等着，我去看一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （并不擅长操作机器的拉薇有些迟疑地站到屏幕面前，一副无从下手的样子。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （我看准时机，偷偷按下了手边的屏幕遥控器，让录像带播放下一面的内容。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （屏幕突然亮起，一个生日蛋糕出现在正中央，正伴随着欢快的生日歌旋转着。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: （因为是我亲手制作的短片，所以制作并不精良……我紧张地看向拉薇，对方则呆立在原地。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 这是你自己制作的影片吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 生日快乐！你不会生气吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 可能技术不够，做得有点粗糙……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 不，我非常、非常喜欢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 可以把这份录像送给我吗？我想把它珍藏起来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 当然可以！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sounds good!

TextContext.SourceString: 我在茶社备了上好的新茶，想邀请你一同前往，没想到你记得我的生日，先来找我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我当然记得。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 为了给拉薇惊喜，我可是提前准备了好久。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 那事不宜迟，我们出发吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 我还准备了这个……配上新茶，味道应该会很不错。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 等等！好像有什么东西从屏幕里跑出来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，这是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 不如再带上这张贺卡？上面有大家和我想对你说的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 贺卡……可以现在就打开看吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TextContext.SourceString: 关于你的一切，我都迫不及待想要了解。
TextContext.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!
